description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations on various linguistic tags, categorized into case, gender, number, and tense, with the horizontal axis labeled 'tag' displaying these four categories in left-to-right order and the vertical axis labeled 'effect' ranging linearly from 0 to 20 with tick marks at intervals of 5 units. Each tag category contains grouped bars representing six distinct models or conditions, color-coded according to the legend: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, pink for mBERT-B₂, and red for XLM-B₂. In the 'case' category, the mBERT-L₂ bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 16, while the XLM-B₂ bar is the shortest, at approximately 11; the XLM-L₂ bar is approximately 5. In the 'gender' category, the mBERT-L₂ bar reaches approximately 3, the XLM-L₂ bar is approximately 1, the mBERT-R₂ bar is approximately 2, the XLM-R₂ bar is approximately 1, the mBERT-B₂ bar is approximately 4, and the XLM-B₂ bar is approximately 3. In the 'number' category, all bars are relatively short, with mBERT-L₂ at approximately 1, XLM-L₂ at approximately 1, mBERT-R₂ at approximately 1, XLM-R₂ at approximately 1, mBERT-B₂ at approximately 3, and XLM-B₂ at approximately 2. In the 'tense' category, all bars are very short, with mBERT-L₂ at approximately 0.5, XLM-L₂ at approximately 0.5, mBERT-R₂ at approximately 0.5, XLM-R₂ at approximately 0.5, mBERT-B₂ at approximately 0.5, and XLM-B₂ at approximately 0.5. Error bars, indicating standard deviation, are present for all bars and are visually longest in the 'gender' category across all models. The bars are not sorted by value, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color-coding and error bars.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations on various linguistic tags, categorized into case, gender, number, and tense. The horizontal axis represents the tag categories, labeled 'tag,' and includes case, gender, number, and tense. The vertical axis is labeled 'effect,' ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5 units. Each tag category features grouped bars representing different models or conditions, distinguished by specific colors corresponding to the legend: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, pink for mBERT-B₂, and red for XLM-B₂. In the 'case' category, mBERT-L₂ consistently exhibits the highest effect, with values exceeding 15, while XLM-B₂ shows the lowest effect, remaining below 5. The 'tense' category demonstrates a steady decline across all models, with values approaching zero. Error bars indicate the standard deviation, with the largest variability observed in the 'gender' category across all models.
